name: return-youtube-dislike
description: Chrome extension to return youtube dislikes

scripts.start: echo To build for development, please use "npm run dev". To build for production, please use "npm run build".
scripts.test:e2e:artifacts: npm run check:extension-artifact && npm run check:userscript-artifact && node Extensions/e2e/hermetic-artifact-smoke.js
scripts.test:e2e:extension:run: npm run check:extension-artifact && playwright test --config playwright.extension.config.js
scripts.test:e2e:extension: npm run build && npm run check:extension-artifact && npm run test:e2e:extension:run
scripts.test:e2e:userscript:run: npm run check:userscript-artifact && playwright test --config playwright.userscript.config.js
scripts.test:e2e:userscript: npm run build:userscript && npm run test:e2e:userscript:run
scripts.test:e2e:systematic: npm run build && npm run check:extension-artifact && npm run build:userscript && npm run test:e2e:artifacts && npm run test:e2e:extension:run && npm run test:e2e:userscript:run
scripts.build:safari: webpack --mode=production && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter Extensions/combined/dist/safari --project-location Extensions/combined/dist --bundle-identifier com.returnyoutubedislike.safari-ext --force

author: Anarios
